contexts.text: Olive groves () = the celestial things (of the Spiritual Church).
That an olive grove = the Celestial Church, and thus celestial good. Illustrated.
The things which are of life are represented in Heaven by olive groves, etc.
An olive grove = the Church as to good.
An olive grove = the Celestial Church, or the Church which is in the good of love to the Lord.
In the Inmost Heaven... olive groves and fig-trees constitute their paradises and forests.
That such things are signified by olive groves, etc. Illustrated.
As an olive grove, and an olive tree = the Church which is in love to the Lord...
By vineyards and olive groves () are signified all things of the Church as to truths and goods.
The Angels of the Third Heaven dwell in the east upon mountains, where olive groves flourish more than all other trees.
